capabilities: Generate graded English articles from pasted, .txt, or PDF word lists via an LLM
Highlight target words and their inflected forms with ==mark== in the generated note
Add optional per-paragraph translations in Chinese, English, or Japanese
Extract 5-10 collocations from the article into a phrase bank table
Verify locally that all target words appear and retry generation up to 3 times
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A built-in mock generator lets users try the full pipeline without an API key; scanned image-only PDFs yield no text unless OCR is applied first.
problem: Memorizing vocabulary words in isolation gives no sense of real usage; Obsidian has no built-in way to generate contextual reading material from a word list at a chosen difficulty level.

relations.evidence: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. Presets included:

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek, Kimi, or OpenAI)

summary: LLM-powered vocabulary tool that turns word lists into graded English articles with highlighted target words, per-paragraph translations, and a phrase bank.
